sources.full_pull_strategy: Use DuckDB spatial + httpfs over Overture S3/Azure GeoParquet; bbox filter Dubai AOI; pull places/buildings/roads/base themes to GeoParquet + GeoJSON sample.
sources.notes: Use for stable cross-source IDs and semantic POI/building/road anchors. Do not download entire theme.

sources.source_name: OpenStreetMap GCC States extract via Geofabrik
sources.full_pull_strategy: Download GCC PBF or GeoPackage from Geofabrik; clip to Dubai AOI with osmium/ogr2ogr; extract roads, buildings, POIs, power/water tags.
sources.notes: PBF and GeoPackage are hundreds of MB; use resumable download and checksum. Keep contributor metadata notice in attribution.

sources.full_pull_strategy: Use Planetary Computer STAC or Delta table; filter by Dubai bbox / quadkey / region; write footprints to GeoParquet with ODbL attribution.
sources.notes: Use as geometry gap fill, not authoritative IDs.

sources.full_pull_strategy: Download UAE 100m/1km population grids for selected years; summarise by community polygons; produce day/night/tourist synthetic priors separately.
sources.notes: Use count per pixel; aggregate by Dubai community and canonical spatial spine.

sources.full_pull_strategy: Pull hourly/daily forecast and historical weather for Dubai/community centroids; store JSON/CSV + normalized weather_observation rows.
sources.notes: No API key for non-commercial use; still rate-limit and cache.

sources.full_pull_strategy: With OPENAQ_API_KEY, query locations by bbox/near Dubai and latest/daily measurements; if sparse locally, use donor-city LA/Delhi/London for distributions.
sources.notes: API v3 now requires X-API-Key for examples and managed access; do not hardcode keys.

sources.source_name: JRC Global Surface Water tile for Dubai region
sources.full_pull_strategy: Download 10°x10° tiles for occurrence/seasonality/recurrence/transitions/max_extent covering Dubai; clip to AOI; derive water/flood context layers.
sources.notes: Large GeoTIFF tiles; use range/resume and process with rasterio/gdal.

sources.source_name: Open Power System Data time series
sources.domain_pack: energy / demand curve donor / synthetic utility dynamics
sources.full_pull_strategy: Download latest time_series package; extract country load/wind/solar/prices; use as donor distributions for synthetic Dubai utility curves, not local Dubai truth.
sources.notes: EU + neighbouring countries; use as shape donor only.

sources.full_pull_strategy: Register app_key; pull line status, disruptions, road events/streets, stop points; join to London/LFB/air-quality resilience pack.
sources.notes: Do not block Dubai P0. Important for Flow 3 resilience donor.

sources.domain_pack: crowd surge / traffic camera donor / Flow 4
sources.full_pull_strategy: Request AccountKey; pull traffic images, bus arrival, taxi availability, road works, traffic incidents; store external media refs only unless licence permits packaging.
sources.notes: Prior scout hit 401; key/auth is the blocker.

sources.full_pull_strategy: Configure cdsapi token; pull ERA5 single-levels for Dubai AOI / donor cities; cache NetCDF/GRIB; normalize rainfall/temp/wind to scenario inputs.
sources.notes: Use Open-Meteo for immediate no-key weather; CDS is authoritative heavier archive.

sources.source_name: Dubai Land Department Real Estate Data
sources.full_pull_strategy: Manual export recent DLD CSVs (transactions/rents/project/valuation/land/building/unit/broker/developer) and/or Dubai Pulse previous-year bulk; normalize to DLD source projections.
sources.notes: Golden path blocker. Web form has captcha/date filters; Codex should prepare importer, human supplies exports.

sources.source_name: Dubai Municipality open data / Dubai Pulse construction-location services
sources.full_pull_strategy: Pull DM building permits, demolition permits, building usages, floor/summary/project info, community/entrances/sectors and Makani open data as available.
sources.notes: High value for DM-shaped source projections and canonical community/address anchors.

sources.source_name: Makani open data / smart address system
sources.full_pull_strategy: Use Makani public web service/open data if accessible; capture 10-digit address/entrance records; never resell raw Makani data; preserve Dubai Municipality attribution.
sources.notes: Address identity anchor. Must follow Makani usage policy.

sources.domain_pack: spatial spine / parcels / communities / roads / buildings
sources.full_pull_strategy: Request/apply for geospatial maps/data or online GIS database access; prioritize communities, sectors, roads, building/land layers, and Amakin browser exports if authorized.
sources.notes: This is the official high-authority Dubai spatial source; use OSM/Overture only as interim fill.
